references.title: DWDS: Hamburger
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for der Hamburger, 'aus den USA stammendes Fastfood'

notes.rationale: The sandwich, der Hamburger, came back to German from English hamburger and DWDS gives it no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word: the Root hamburger and the zero ending (ADR 0050: a loan blended abroad has no Constituents, as Motel; ADR 0051). Someone from Hamburg splits Hamburg + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split). The judges split on it, and the user ruled on 2026-10-25 (#1241): German borrowed it whole from English, so it gets no Constituents.
